mechanism_narrative: Lower federal funds rate levels (FEDFUNDS) reduce the risk-free rate, increasing the present value of equity cash flows and leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 6.0%, it indicates a weakening labor market and potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns as risk-off sentiment intensifies.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 6.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a contraction in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as economic growth fears rise.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 950.0 and RSAFS < 430000.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0 and GDP (GDPC1) is below 16000.0, it signals a deteriorating supply-side economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns as recession risks increase.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 100.0 and GDPC1 < 16000.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (defined by FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and CPIAUCSL > 250.0), S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative due to increased interest rates and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are not significantly negative during periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.0 and CPIAUCSL > 250.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5.0% and employment (PAYEMS) exceeds 138000.0, it indicates a tight labor market that may trigger inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns as central banks tighten policy.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE < 5.0 and PAYEMS > 138000.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (defined by HOUST > 1000.0 and GDP (GDPC1) > 16000.0), S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative due to overvaluation and increased risk of policy tightening.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are not significantly negative during late-cycle expansion (HOUST > 1000.0 and GDPC1 > 16000.0) (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
